details.description: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash is DeepSeek's multimodal mixture-of-experts chat model, released September 10, 2026 as the smallest model in a new architecture family and reached via the API model id deepseek-flash. It uses a Causal Encoder-Decoder design with 552 billion backbone parameters but activates only 8 billion for input processing and 16 billion for output generation, and it processes images alongside text natively from pretraining. DeepSeek reports that internal and third-party tests place it ahead of the larger DeepSeek-V4-Pro on performance, cost, speed and total runtime despite the much smaller active-parameter count. It succeeds the earlier DeepSeek-V4-Flash (public beta July 2026); the legacy ids deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are retired and now route to this model, billed at Flash pricing.
advantages: Scores 90.9% (Pass@1) on GPQA Diamond, a graduate-level science reasoning benchmark.
Resolves 74.2% of tasks on the DeepSWE v1.1 software-engineering agent benchmark.
Passes 90.6% (Pass@1) of tasks on Terminal-Bench 2.1, a benchmark for agentic terminal use.
Natively processes images and text through a built-in vision encoder from pretraining rather than a later-added adapter.
Supports a continuously controllable reasoning-effort setting (1-100) that trades inference cost for accuracy.
DeepSeek reports internal and third-party tests place it ahead of the larger DeepSeek-V4-Pro model on performance, cost, speed and total runtime.
disadvantages: No audio input or output; modality is limited to text and images.
use_cases: Agentic coding and terminal/command-line automation, with documented integration into Claude Code, OpenCode and OpenClaw.
Software-engineering agents that resolve repository bug-fixing tasks.
Visual-understanding tasks that combine images with tool use.
Long-context agentic workflows using up to a 1,000,000-token context window.
General chat and reasoning tasks with adjustable reasoning effort.

notes: Catalog facts (1,000,000 input tokens; 393,216 = 384K output tokens; image+text modality, no audio) match DeepSeek's own pricing and model-card figures, no conflicts. 'deepseek-flash' resolves to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (released Sept 10, 2026), which supersedes the earlier DeepSeek-V4-Flash (public beta July 2026); legacy ids deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp now route to it. The model card lists many more agentic benchmark scores (e.g. ProgramBench, NL2Repo-Bench, SEC-Bench Pro, ExploitGym, AutomationBench, Terminal-Bench 3.0/4.0) that were left out here for brevity but are consistent in kind with the ones included; a Codeforces rating (3471) was excluded as not an 0-100 accuracy score.
